paragraphs.text:
You  see  the  conflict  in  Charlie’s  face.  “You  speak  with  great 
learning,  Professor.  Perhaps  I  was  foolish  to  believe  the  stories 
the elders tell of the Little Ones.” She clenches her fists. “I am 
rational, like you.”
Charlie resumes her duties and your party moves on.
Roll 1D10: if the result is even, go to 10; if the result is odd, go to 11.
